source: OURS: our own progression choices where the client tables we have stop (docs/PROGRESSION.md). 'params' is hand-edited; 'generated' is written by `python tools/progression.py` from params, tools/data/class-skills.json and tools/data/dev-menu.json. Nothing here is retail data.

unlock.about: OURS. SkillAcquireData auto-learn rows end at level 25. The skills the client's developer kit Class_<class> (DevTeleportDataTable, dev-menu.json) lists for a class but no recovered unlock gives it are spread evenly over first_level..last_level (null = the level cap).

skill_level_damage.about: OURS. Damage, heals and damage over time grow by per_level (1/10000) for each skill level above 1 (skill levels are bought with skill points, GameSession.SkillLevels.cs). No SkillEffect rows per skill level were exported.

damage_fallbacks.14170000: Explosion Trap (Ranger): an MP-costing 20 s attack with no Damage row in the export
damage_fallbacks.17150000: Divine Aura (Cleric): a MainTarget 30 s skill with no Damage row and no skill-effects.json entry

mastery.about: OURS. Skill levels 2-10 for fallback skills: the recovered SkillAcquireData Mastery cost ladder, one step every step_levels levels after the unlock.

mp_max.about: OURS. PcStatLevel holds FixingDamage, Defense and HPMax only. MPMax 1500 at level 1 is OBSERVED (the official 0x3649 sample, a level-1 character); the growth per level is ours.

combat_power.about: OURS. combat power = sum of stat x weight, attack = mean weapon damage + FixingDamage (level) + WeaponFixingDamage (gear). Every weight is positive, so better gear never lowers it.
